messages:
Priya: Saw a cluster of 401s after a scheduled master-key rotation yesterday. Problem summary: hosted CP rotated, some private-sidecars didn't get the push, adapters attempted rebinds and flooded control plane. We need a clear ownership model for rebind orchestration.

Zack: Quick stance: control plane should coordinate rotations for hosted flows (push). For private/offline, adapters must be able to operate autonomously (pull/signed-lease). So we need an explicit hybrid contract.

Maya: Hybrid makes sense. Important: define an offline-first signed-lease shape and verification rules so adapters can validate without CP contact. Also add nonce+aud claim to avoid replay.

Eli: Concern: during rotation we may invalidate tokens used by in-flight requests. We should define a KV-cache invalidation barrier: either token is request-scoped or a short grace window where old tokens remain valid until requests finish.

Priya: Ops impact: yesterday retries from adapters caused spikes in control plane auth requests and triggered rate limits, exacerbating outage. We need backoff + advisory header so proxies can suppress retries.

SRE-Leah: Suggested server-side policy: if tenant rebind_failures > 5 in 60s, mark tenant degraded and route to fallback model; emit alert and mute rotations for that tenant. Also add metrics: auth.rebind_attempts, auth.rebind_failures, auth.rebind_backoff_seconds.

Zack: Draft config for adapter:
```
adapter.auth_mode = "hybrid" # push | pull | hybrid
adapter.signed_lease_ttl = "300s"
adapter.lease_jitter = 0.25
adapter.max_rebinds_per_min = 6
adapter.local_kms = "http://127.0.0.1:8200" # optional
```
Defaults: hybrid + 300s TTL.

Maya: Signed-lease format proposal: base64(signed) {adapter_id, tenant_id, exp, nonce, aud}. Sign with CP key. Adapters validate signature and exp locally. CP rotates signing keys and publishes key ids.

Eli: For KV cache: make tokens strictly request-scoped when possible. Otherwise implement a swap-barrier: on rebind, mark adapter state as DRAINING, reject new requests briefly while swapping cache, then resume. Document latency SLO hit for that window.

Priya: Thundering herd mitigation: adapters should emit `X-Rebind-State: in-progress` when they start a rebind. Control plane and upstream proxies can use it to suppress aggressive client retries. Also add exponential backoff with capped jitter to rebind attempts.

SRE-Leah: Runbook snippet:
- If auth.rebind_failures spikes -> run `rb rotate-suppress --tenant T` to pause rotations for tenant.
- If adapter-side rebinds failing across many hosts, mark cluster degraded and failover to dedicated fallback region.

Zack: Action items:
- I'll write an RFC comparing push-first vs pull-first models + signed-lease spec.
- Maya: add signed-lease schema + validation pseudo-code to RFC.
- Eli: propose KV-cache barrier and SLO impact statement.
- Leah: add metrics + runbook entries and alert thresholds.

rotations-bot: Check: unit tests for adapter rebind logic passed (14/14). Integration on private env flaky (2/5). See CI: https://ci.redwood.example/4928642001 :hammer_and_wrench:

Priya: Thanks. Let's avoid bikeshedding TTL here; put defaults in config PR and discuss corner cases in RFC next architecture sync.

Maya: I'll sketch a reference implementation for the signed-lease validator in go and attach to RFC.

Eli: One more corner: cross-tenant leases — ensure leases cannot be swapped between tenants; include tenant_id and enforce strict match.

Priya: Good. RFC link when ready and we can vote during next arch sync. :thumbsup:
